item.title: Lake Kasumigaura: Cycling Around Japan's Second Largest Lake — Guide
item.description: Lake Kasumigaura is Japan’s second-largest lake by surface area, its wide, flat horizons and traditional sailboats (once used for freshwater fishing) creating a distinctly open, peaceful landscape unlike the mountain-ringed lakes found elsewhere in Japan. A well-maintained cycling route, known as ‘Rin-Rin Road,’ circles roughly 180 km around the lake’s shoreline, passing lakeside towns, fishing harbours and rest stops, making it one of the most popular long-distance cycling routes in the Kanto region.
